title: Assessing the Construct Validity of Object-Oriented, Class-Level Code Quality Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2609.20411v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Code quality metrics are intended to measure latent properties of software source code. Although numerous code metrics have been proposed and used, their construct validity is rarely evaluated. Thus, the extent to which code metrics actually measure what they claim to measure is often unclear. Aim: Drawing from modern measurement theory, we investigate the construct validity of common class-level, object-oriented code quality metrics by identifying their factor structure using Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA). The metrics were extracted from the Apache Maven project by three software tools: Designite, JHawk, and Understand. The factor structure was later verified using Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) on 22 randomly selected open source projects meeting a predetermined eligibility criteria. translated_title: 评估面向对象类级代码质量指标的结构效度
translated_abstract: 背景：代码质量指标旨在测量软件源代码的潜在属性。尽管已经提出并使用了大量代码指标，但其结构效度很少被评估。因此，代码指标实际上在多大程度上测量了它们声称要测量的内容，往往是不清楚的。目的：借鉴现代测量理论，我们通过使用探索性因子分析（EFA）识别因子结构，来研究常见的类级面向对象代码质量指标的结构效度。这些指标由三个软件工具（Designite、JHawk和Understand）从Apache Maven项目中提取。随后在22个随机选择且满足预定资格标准的开源项目上，使用验证性因子分析（CFA）验证了该因子结构。结果：24个代码质量指标对应于六个构念：内聚性、入耦合、出耦合、规模、子继承（后文被截断）。
tldr: 本研究借助探索性因子分析与验证性因子分析评估了常见面向对象类级代码质量指标的结构效度，发现24个指标可归纳为内聚性、入耦合、出耦合、规模、子继承等六个构念。
en_tdlr: This study assesses the construct validity of common class-level object-oriented code quality metrics using EFA and CFA, finding that 24 metrics correspond to six constructs including cohesion, in-coupling, out-coupling, size, and sub-inheritance.
